description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Kudahapola & Ekala, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District for sewerage line extension poject
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition and servitude rights for specific properties (described in detailed schedules with boundaries, locations, and claimant information) required for a sewerage project. This falls under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions and rights, which is the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While a government minister is named and exercises power under a legal act, the core subject matter is land, not government structure/personnel or the legal framework itself.
